statement: The combination of vapor-assisted growth and phenethylammonium iodide passivation has not been reported.

statement: Few studies quantify moisture-driven lattice strain at the grain boundary.

statement: It is unknown whether the improved T80 lifetime at 45% relative humidity is retained at 85% relative humidity.
